hints.title: Dominance Over Second Largest
hints.text: The largest number is at least twice as large as every other element if and only if it is at least twice as large as the second largest element.

hints.title: Dual Extremum Tracking Invariant
hints.text: Tracking only the highest value along with its original index and the second highest value requires only a single pass through the array.

hints.title: Single Pass Extremum Comparison Procedure
hints.text: Initialize variables for the maximum value, its index, and the second maximum value. In a single pass, update the highest and second highest values. After the pass, check if the maximum is greater than or equal to two times the second maximum. Return the index if true, else return negative one.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the array takes O(N log N) time and loses original element indices unless paired into tuples.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking the top two numbers in a single linear pass takes O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid sorting and correctly retain the original index of the maximum element.
